worker_claim.report: The resolver performs one read-only `commit_changes` observation per execution-history commit, then runs the existing multi-observation exact proof only for the selected newest candidate, eliminating the history x reports subprocess cross-product. Existing curator-note and altered-review-content behavior remains covered.
worker_claim.summary: Hardened `execution_provenance.py` to index report-path history changes, select only the newest accepted review-generation candidate, and fail closed on invalid or modified current evidence without falling back to stale executions. Reused the existing exact lifecycle proof and preserved the thin runtime seam; runtime dependencies and LOC are unchanged, with no new dependencies. Added a real-Git same-checkpoint retry regression covering newest-generation binding.
